title: MultiSelectSearchableDropdown
description: A multi-select dropdown with search filtering, chip display, async loading, and keyboard navigation.

content.description: React.ReactNode - Custom content rendered in the option list.

selectedContent.description: React.ReactNode - Content shown when this option is selected.

defaultValue.description: Initial selected values for uncontrolled usage.

onValueChange.description: (values: string[], options: MultiSelectOption[]) => void - Fires when the selected values change.

id.description: HTML id attribute for the trigger element.

placeholder.description: React.ReactNode - Placeholder when nothing is selected.

error.description: Displays the dropdown in an error state.

errorMessage.description: React.ReactNode - Error message displayed below the dropdown.

label.description: React.ReactNode - Label rendered above the dropdown.

description.description: React.ReactNode - Description text rendered below the label.

success.description: Displays the dropdown in a success state.

successMessage.description: React.ReactNode - Success message displayed below the dropdown.

showSearch.description: Whether to show the search input in the dropdown.

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the search input.

noResultsContent.description: React.ReactNode - Content shown when no options match the search.

loadingText.description: React.ReactNode - Text shown during async loading.

shimmerCount.description: Number of shimmer placeholder items shown during loading.

clearable.description: Shows a clear button to deselect all values.

showChevron.description: Whether to show the chevron icon in the trigger.

fullWidth.description: Makes the dropdown span the full width of its container.

onSearch.description: (query: string) => Promise<MultiSelectOption[]> - Async search callback for server-side filtering.

searchDebounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds for the search callback.

initialOptions.description: Options to display before any search is performed.

onLoadInitialOptions.description: () => Promise<MultiSelectOption[]> - Async function to load initial options.

loadInitialOnOpen.description: When true, calls onLoadInitialOptions each time the dropdown opens.

onLoadError.description: (error: unknown) => void - Called when async loading or search fails.

maxDisplayedChips.description: Maximum number of selected chips displayed before showing a count.

showSelectedChips.description: Whether to show selected values as chips in the trigger.

checkboxIcon.description: React.ReactNode - Custom checkbox icon for options.

lockScroll.description: Locks body scroll while the dropdown is open.

classes.description: CSS class overrides for dropdown sub-elements.

className.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

style.description: Inline styles for the root element.

defaultOpen.description: Whether the dropdown is initially open (uncontrolled).

onOpenChange.description: (open: boolean) => void - Fires when the open state changes.

portalContainer.description: HTMLElement | null - Portal target for the dropdown popup.

dropdownPosition.description: Vertical placement of the dropdown relative to the trigger.

forceDropdownPosition.description: Locks the dropdown to the specified position without auto-flipping.

dropdownGap.description: Gap in pixels between trigger and dropdown popup.

keepMounted.description: Keeps the dropdown DOM mounted when closed.

onBlur.description: () => void - Fires when the dropdown loses focus.

onFocus.description: () => void - Fires when the dropdown receives focus.

onKeyDown.description: (event: React.KeyboardEvent) => void - Fires on keydown events.

ClearIcon.description: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }> - Custom clear icon component.

renderTrigger.description: (props: MultiSelectSearchableDropdownTriggerRenderProps) => ReactNode - Custom render function for the trigger.

searchInputAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the search input.
